title: Sky_Pillar
lead_summary:
The Sky Pillar can be reached by ship once the player has met with both Groudon and Kyogre and has spoken to the elderly man in Kin Island. From there, a new option in the harbour will be available for the player.
To progress up the tower, the player must walk over several patterns of broken tiles. If stopped on a broken tile, you will fall down a floor.

items.name: TM108 Sky Attack
items.location_details: On the higher ground in the cavern.
